################################################################################
Purpose of script: To check the waic results of the experiments 
################################################################################

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")
library(colorspace)
theme_set(theme_classic() + theme(strip.background = element_blank()))
dirs <- lapply(dirs, function(x) paste0("../", x))
```

# Check waic of the photoperiod models 
```{r}
# Read in rhats data of the models
rhats <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$rhats}/all_rhats.rds"))

# Read in the waic of the models that converged
waic_df <- bind_rows(lapply(str_subset(list.files(glue("{dirs$waic}"), full.names = TRUE), 
                         "archiv|all", negate = TRUE), readRDS)) %>%
  select(mod, Estimate_waic) %>%
  rename(waic = Estimate_waic) %>%
  mutate(pat = sub(".*s08_(.*?)_(base|cs|csi).*", "\\1", mod),
         mod_name = str_remove_all(str_remove(string = mod, pattern = pat), 
                                   "bmvl_s08__|bmv1_s08__|_gauss.rds|.rds"),
         vac = sub(".*bmv(.*?)_s08(.*?)_.*", "\\1\\2", mod)) %>%
  left_join(pat_tidy_names) %>%
  left_join(rhats, by = join_by(mod)) %>%
  filter(Rhat_cond) %>%
  arrange(waic) %>%
  group_by(pat) %>%
  mutate(delta_waic = waic - waic[1])

# Save it 
saveRDS(waic_df, glue("{dirs$waic}/all_waic.rds"))

# Check waic table per pathogen
waic_l <- sapply(unique(waic_df$pat), function(x) filter(waic_df, pat == x), simplify = FALSE)
waic_l$rota

# Check best for each pathogen
waic_df %>%
  group_by(pat) %>%
  mutate(waic_base = waic[mod_name == "base"]) %>%
  arrange(pat, waic) %>%
  mutate(waic_best = waic[1]) %>%
  mutate(delta_waic = waic_base - waic_best) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  select(pat, mod, delta_waic, waic_base, waic_best, vac)
```

# Plot waic comparisons 
```{r}
pl_waic <- waic_df %>%
  mutate(pat_tidy = factor(pat_tidy, levels = pat_tidy_names$pat_tidy)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = delta_waic, y = mod_name, color = mod_name)) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 1), color = "grey", linetype = "dotted") + 
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = 0, yend = mod_name), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.3) + 
  scale_x_continuous("Delta WAIC (log10)", trans = "log10") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "grey", "red","red", "red", "red")) +
  facet_wrap(pat_tidy~., scales = "free_y", ncol = 5) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.title.y = element_blank()) 
  
ggsave(pl_waic, file = glue("{dirs$figures}/mod_waic.pdf"), height = 7, width = 11)
```
